fields.name: externalOrderId
fields.rule: Your own id for the order. It is the order's identity in Akeed.

fields.name: customerName
fields.rule: The customer's name as it should appear in the message.

fields.name: customerPhone
fields.rule: International format with `+` and the country code, for example `+201001234567`.

fields.name: totalPrice
fields.rule: A decimal **string** greater than zero with at most 2 decimals, for example `"450.00"`. A JSON number is rejected.

fields.name: currency
fields.rule: One of the supported currency codes listed below.

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.rule: How the customer pays, in your own words, for example `cod` or `Credit Card`.

fields.name: orderNumber
fields.rule: The number the customer sees in the message. Defaults to `externalOrderId` as you wrote it.

fields.name: orderDate
fields.rule: The day the order was placed, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. A timestamp is rejected.

fields.name: notes
fields.rule: Anything your team should see beside the order.

errors.meaning: A field, the `Idempotency-Key` header or the JSON itself is invalid. `fieldErrors` names each problem.
errors.action: Fix the request. Sending it again unchanged fails the same way.

errors.meaning: The request was refused for a reason that has no code of its own. The status can be any 4xx.
errors.action: Check the method, path and headers against this guide.

errors.meaning: The key is missing, mistyped, revoked, sent in the URL, or not sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
errors.action: Check the header. If the key was revoked or lost, create a new one in **Settings → API keys**.

errors.meaning: This `Idempotency-Key` was already used for different order data.
errors.action: Use one key per order. Do not reuse a key for another order or for a changed order.

errors.meaning: Akeed already has an order with this `externalOrderId`, and its data is different.
errors.action: Orders cannot be changed through the API. Open the order in the dashboard, or use a new `externalOrderId` if it really is a new order.

errors.meaning: The store this key belongs to cannot take orders: it was deactivated or replaced. A store that is not a Standalone store answers the same code with status 403.
errors.action: Sign in to Akeed and check the store. Contact support if it looks active.

errors.meaning: The store has not finished setup.
errors.action: Finish setup in the Akeed app, then send the order again with the same key.

errors.meaning: Automatic confirmation is turned off for the store.
errors.action: Turn it on in **Settings**, then send the order again with the same key.

errors.meaning: The store has no active plan or billing.
errors.action: Open **Billing & credits** in the Akeed app.

errors.meaning: The confirmations included for this period are used up.
errors.action: Open **Billing & credits** in the Akeed app.

errors.meaning: The credit balance cannot cover one more message.
errors.action: Buy credits, then send the order again with the same key.

errors.meaning: The credit account has a negative balance to settle first.
errors.action: Open **Billing & credits** and settle the balance.

errors.meaning: The store has no credit account.
The request body is larger than the limit.
errors.action: Send one order per request and keep the text fields short.

errors.meaning: Too many requests in one minute.
errors.action: Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`, then send the request again with the same key.
Retry with the same key. If it keeps failing, send support the `correlationId`.

errors.meaning: The order could not be stored. Nothing was saved.
The order was stored, but its confirmation could not be queued.
errors.action: Retry with the same key. The retry queues the same order and never creates a second one.

examples.title: Create an order
examples.intro: A cash-on-delivery order from a ready store. `202` means Akeed stored the order. The WhatsApp message is sent afterwards.

examples.title: Send the same request again
examples.intro: The same `Idempotency-Key` with the same body returns the original order with `duplicate: true`. No second order, message or credit.

steps.note: Once Akeed has started the confirmation, the answer also carries its `verificationId`.

examples.title: Retry after a lost response
examples.intro: Your request timed out and you do not know whether Akeed received it. Send exactly the same request again, with the same `Idempotency-Key`. If the first one arrived, you get the same order back.

examples.title: Same key, different order data
examples.intro: The key `order-10023` was already used for an order of 450.00. Sending it with another amount is refused, and the stored order is not changed.

body.message: Idempotency-Key was already used with different order data.

examples.title: New key for an order Akeed already has
examples.intro: Order `10023` already exists. Sending it again under a new key, with identical data, returns the existing order. Nothing new is stored or sent.

examples.title: New key, same order id, different data
examples.intro: Order `10023` already exists with the note "Call before delivery". A new key with a different note is refused: a create request never updates an order.

body.message: An order with this externalOrderId already exists with different order data.

examples.title: Same order id, written differently
examples.intro: Order `10023` already exists. `#10023` is the same order, but without an `orderNumber` the customer-facing number is taken from the id as written, so the data differs and the request is refused.

body.message: An order with this externalOrderId already exists with different order data.

steps.note: Sending the original number as `orderNumber` makes the data identical again:

examples.title: An order that is not cash on delivery
examples.intro: A prepaid order is accepted and appears in the dashboard, but Akeed never messages the customer and no credit is used. The answer has no `verificationId`.

steps.note: Sending it again later gives the same order, still without a `verificationId`.

examples.title: Invalid phone number
examples.intro: The phone has no `+` and country code. `fieldErrors` names the field to fix.

examples.title: Invalid API key
examples.intro: A revoked, unknown or mistyped key gets the same answer, so the response never reveals which keys exist.

body.message: A valid API key is required.

examples.title: Request body too large
examples.intro: A body over 32 KB is refused before anything else is checked.

body.message: The request body is too large.

examples.title: Too many requests
examples.intro: The store already sent 60 requests in the last minute. Wait the number of seconds in `Retry-After`, then send the same request again.

body.message: Too many requests. Wait for the Retry-After period, then retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

examples.title: Automatic confirmation is turned off
examples.intro: The store cannot send messages right now, so the order is refused instead of being stored and forgotten.

body.message: Enable automatic verification before submitting orders.

examples.title: Store setup is not finished
examples.intro: The store behind the key has not completed setup.

body.message: Complete Standalone setup before submitting orders.

examples.title: Store cannot accept orders
examples.intro: The store behind the key was deactivated or replaced.

body.message: The store this API key belongs to cannot accept orders.

examples.title: Not enough credits
examples.intro: The balance cannot cover one more message. Nothing is stored. Buy credits, then send the order again with the same key.

body.message: Credit is not available for this action.
